ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels and 40% low-intensity black pixels, creating a high-contrast pattern across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer lateral sections of both lobes. A central, low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle through the median notch. Irregular dark mottling and focal spots are present within the white regions, particularly on the inner lower section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of these variations increases significantly towards the distal tips where the edge appears jagged and uneven.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a primarily concave trajectory from the median notch towards the tips, while the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, circular low-intensity dark spots are visible on the lower-center white area of the right lobe; significant high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) are present at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin, unaligned dark linear disruptions are detectable on the upper white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable bio-fouling or barnacle colonization present as thick, irregular protrusions on both the left and right distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, irregularly shaped black intrusion extends from the central black pigment mass into the upper white field of the right lobe.
